start.text: Take a seat, friend.~ Take a seat, =name=.~ Rest your bones, friend.~ Rest your bones, =name=.~ Fancy a rock?~ Come sit and rock your troubles away.~ Why am I here?~ Why are we here?~ Why are we here, =name=?~ Hee haw hee haw hee haw hee haw.~ Sway like leaves in the wind, my tall friend.~ Sit.~ Sit.~ Be still.~ Condense your motion to the Interval.~ The Interval is Periodic. It spans two ways: this and that.~ Don't you want to simplify your life?~ Be in the moment, =name=.~ Savor the moment.
